resolved_previous_findings.resolution: Witness binds full canonical claim, provenance and context. Predicate/scope edits refuse carry.

Witness records actual checked commit/input hash, gate matches prior state last_checked_commit, and blob guard compares before/after module identities directly to last actual mismatch module. Signature candidate also compares current signature/AST directly with actual witness.
Context includes mandatory canonical enclosing plan binding; setup separately records candidate-only source/context hashing costs.
Timing rows distinguish pack repetitions from actual history/transition executions.

premises: Witness minted only by trusted runner from actual structural contradicted/predicate_mismatch result with matching production input hash.
Snapshots and object IDs come from authentic production Git snapshot reader; source/index/context/configuration identities remain honestly bound.
Original genuine production symbol_validate selection is preserved unless its sole reason is previously_unavailable.
Exact syntactic signature scope, complete dependency-free research provenance and extant regular subject module are required.
bounded_soundness.argument: With same full module Git object as the actual mismatch and unchanged parser/roots/validator/claim context, production module parsing, binding ambiguity and normalized signature are unchanged. Genuine regular exact path also excludes non-tree ancestors. The fixed expectation therefore remains mismatched. This proof is relative to production structural semantics and trusted witness creation.
bounded_soundness.uncertainty_and_recovery: Missing/nonregular/limited modules, changed context/claim, extra production reasons and invalid witnesses retain validation. Actual uncertain/supported validation replaces witness with None. A recovered signature differs from actual negative module and is revalidated immediately, including after keep_all policy switch.
limits: Not independent truth or proof for all Python bindings.
No witness authenticates an untrusted caller: matching result hash is identity consistency, not proof a validator executed.
Uses genuine Git object identity; hand-constructed inconsistent snapshots and hash-collision attacks are outside this experiment.
Signature candidate still repeats substantial validator checks; full-module candidate is deliberately more conservative.

charged_inside_loop: Actual validate_claim calls for selected transitions
outside_region_disclosed: Fresh correctness validation and independent reference
measurement_review.sequential_state: Each run_history starts from its own actual parent result and evolves its own states/witness; fresh/reference fields are consulted only for post-transition correctness.
measurement_review.order: Rotation plus odd-repetition reversal covers all six three-variant permutations in each six-repetition cycle.
measurement_review.checks: Work counters and final state endpoints checked after each complete timed block; correctness checked per transition outside timing. Wall/CPU distributions and paired deltas retained; short blocks counted against explicit floor.
measurement_review.interpretation: No elapsed benefit is established by this review. Keep performance recommendation inconclusive until actual paired results, variation and limiter evidence are examined. Maintenance-only timings exclude shared index work and do not establish end-to-end corpus savings.

scope: Only the 17 enumerated authored histories. Older broad matrix is unimplemented historical planning, not claimed coverage.
